# World Support



Scouting America and its International Department have created several avenues
of financial support of the world Scouting movement. Those avenues include the
following:



[![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/12/Logo-300x204.jpg)](https://www.scouting.org/international/information-sheets/22-329/)| | The [**World Friendship Fund** ](https://www.scouting.org/international/information-sheets/22-329/)of the BSA offers a practical Good Turn opportunity for BSA youth members and leaders. Cash contributions are used to assist Scouting through the World Organization of the Scout Movement and through national Scout associations in developing countries. Tax-deductible contributions can be from individuals, units, camp, and training course groups. Unit participation in the World Friendship Fund offers a unique annual service project to benefit brother Scouts around the world.[Click here to download World Friendship Fund donation form](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/wff-brochure.pdf)[Click here to donate online](https://www.scouting.org/international/donations)  
---|---|---  
[![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/12/300px-World_scout_foundation-300x163.png)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20300%20163%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://www.scouting.org/international/information-sheets/22-331/)|  | The [**World  Baden-Powell Fellowship**](https://www.scouting.org/international/information-sheets/22-331/) established on 25th April 1982 in Kolmaarden (Sweden), recognizes individuals for their contributions to the World Scout Foundation to help support world Scouting. Fellowship receptions are periodically held in different parts of the world to both inform members about Scouting and to welcome new members who are personally awarded a special insignia by His Majesty The King of Sweden.Click here to download the [World Baden-Powell Fellowship Enrollment Form](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/BadenPowellEnrollForm-PayInstr_Final_240320b.pdf)  
[![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/Gilwell-Logo.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20214%20161%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://www.scoutadventures.org.uk/centre/gilwell-park)|  | [**Gilwell Park**](https://www.scoutadventures.org.uk/centre/gilwell-park), for many, is the spiritual home of Scouting: it embodies Lord Baden-Powell’s dream of a dedicated training center for Scouts. The Gilwell Fellow program has been developed to help protect the heritage of Gilwell Park for future generations.Click here to download the [Gilwell Fellow Enrollment Form](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Gilwell_FellowEnrollForm-PayInstr_Final_240320a.pdf).Click here to download the [Gilwell Fellow Brochure](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/FD_Gilwell_Fellows_leaflet_WEB.pdf).  
[![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/KISC.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20150%20150%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://www.kisc.ch/)|  | [**Kandersteg International** **Scout Center**](https://www.kisc.ch/) was founded in 1923. Lord Baden-Powell said that he dreamt of one place in the world, where the “Jamboree” feeling – feeling of world brotherhood, peace and international friendship – would happen all year long. That place is KISC the Permanent Mini Jamboree. Join over 500 Members in supporting the Dream by becoming a member of the KISC Association.Click Here to Download the [KISC Membership Brochure](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/2018.Membership-Information-EN-1.pdf)Click Here to Download the [KISC Donation Form](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/KanderstegEnrollForm-PayInstr_240320.pdf)  
 [![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/12/a-world01-300x300.jpg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20199%20199%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://www.scouting.org/international/information-sheets/22-332/)|  | The [**United States Fund for International Scouting**](https://www.scouting.org/international/information-sheets/22-332/) (USFIS), within the National Scouting America Foundation, maintains the funds contributed to the World Friendship Fund.This fund is administered by the USFIS committee an appointed sub-committee of the BSA International Committee. The National Scouting America Foundation has full tax privileges and is not a private foundation.Collected contributions are used to assist developing National Scout Organizations (NSO) around the world. Any NSO that is recognized by the World Organization of the Scout Movement (WOSM) can submit a grant request for projects to enhance their growing organization. Every February, May, and October the USFIS committee reviews these grant requests.  
  
Details on any of these programs are available by contacting the
[International Department](mailto:international@scouting.org).
